ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: On the basis of the given food web, which organism will increase in number if there were no seals?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web there is a seal labeled Seal, located in the upper, slightly middle position of the figure; in the center there is a large octopus, labeled Octopus Food Web. Blue arrows show food relationships, and the arrow direction is from the organism being eaten toward the organism that eats it. For example, the arrow of Plankton points to Big Shrimp, and the arrow of the central octopus points to Seal, indicating that the seal eats the octopus. Reasoning: The question asks which organism's number would increase if there were no seals. Because in the figure the arrow goes from the octopus toward the seal, it shows that the octopus is the prey of the seal. After removing the seal, the predation pressure on the octopus decreases, therefore the number of octopuses will increase.
